jobs.descripcion:

jobs.titulo: How AI Clones a Voice From 3 Seconds of Audio (Explained in 4 Minutes)
jobs.descripcion:
Three seconds of your voice is all it takes. In this video, you'll learn how AI turns a tiny audio clip into a full vocal clone: your voiceprint, the numbers behind it, and the synthesis that speaks words you never said.

You'll also see the good uses — giving voices back, dubbing films, helping people who can't speak — and the dark side: scam calls, fake executives, and election deepfakes. Plus three practical ways to protect yourself and your family.
